topic: Deployment and client communication for new release
summary_markdown: The latest release notes were shared, detailing updates such as updated room membership. A discussion occurred regarding the deployment timeline, with Japan awaiting specific features (referred to as a 'firewall'). It was confirmed that the release could be deployed on the day of the conversation, and the client newsletter would be sent afterward.
decisions: The new release will be deployed today.
Client communication about the release will be handled via a post-factum newsletter.
action_items: Someone needs to review the release notes and prepare the client newsletter.
